cases.name: Interruption after a durably persisted produced body before evaluation completes
preconditions: S1 attempt reservation and exact source/input/recipe/contract identities are durably linked.
S2 native producer's original response is durably available with exact response bytes; no synthetic acceptance.
A valid currently served baseline exists through the real governed door.
cases.interruption_point: After native production response and result CAS bytes are durable, before evaluation has completed and before any activation.
actions: Record pre-interruption process ID, candidate/source identities, response/result hashes and reservation.
Interrupt the owned process and preserve its exit/signal and uncensored non-secret outputs.
Start a new process using the existing adapter's restore entry point returned by S2/S5.
Reconcile durable original response and uncertain evaluation request before any further inference; never repeat the producer to reconstruct missing provenance.
Perform authorized evaluation only after reservation/uncertainty reconciliation; activate only if complete accepted manifest passes governed check and emit.
Use the public runtime reader in a separate process and record returned identities or HOLD.
required_observations: No second production request for the completed identity.
Unresolved evaluation stays UNCERTAIN until evidence resolves it; retry, if explicitly admitted, is a new attempt.
A CAS body without complete reviews/receipt is never treated as publishable.
Current reader stays on a compatible accepted manifest or HOLD throughout.
cases.baseline_gap: ownership-rebuild.ts puts body/result before evaluate, but it has no durable completion/address/cursor input. A HOLD does not return those refs or calls. Native importer must provide actual restore behavior.

cases.name: Interruption after one reviewed artifact changes result and before a dependent artifact finishes
preconditions: Freeze accepted baseline manifest with required edge B -> A.
Choose a real S1 scope and source drift for which S2's actual recipe changes A's result.
S1 quota/reservation covers only the actual needed work and evaluator requests.
cases.interruption_point: After A's body/result/reviews/receipt/artifact are durable and before B completion or final candidate activation.
actions: Record all completed identities and the exact interruption point from the running process.
Interrupt and record exit/signal without deleting the isolated store.
Resume in a distinct process through the candidate's real completion-selection API.
Revalidate completed A against current source, recipe, contract, required results and reviews.
Reuse matching completion A without invoking its producer again; complete only B and remaining affected work.
Construct and validate the complete final candidate; use check and atlas-emit for isolated activation.
required_observations: A's original completion and reviews survive process death and are selected by stable identity.
Producer invocation counts and IDs demonstrate zero new work for completed A.
No incomplete partial manifest is served.
Uncertain attempts/reservations remain unreleased unless reconciled.
Final reader's required closure is coherent and tied to the final manifest.
cases.baseline_gap: A new invocation of rebuildOwnershipUpdate only accepts a baseline manifest. Its in-memory candidateArtifacts/calls/newResults do not survive interruption. Passing its partial manifest is insufficient when B still binds the old A result: planOwnershipUpdate historically validates all entries and readOwnership still checks dependency bindings.

cases.name: Real source drift followed by failed rebuild cannot serve stale current knowledge
preconditions: Exact S1 requested closure plus a truly independent scope are frozen.
S2 accepted baseline and actual recipe/evaluator are bound.
Both initial current reads are observed ready via runtime.ownership.read in the isolated target.
cases.failure_point: After an actual required source edit is observed, cause the real rebuild path to return blocked/HOLD or terminate at its declared failure seam; do not replace the production recipe with a fixed fake success.
actions: Capture source bytes/version and baseline published manifest before drift.
Apply the isolated source edit and record the new observed version.
Invoke the actual rebuild/update entry point and capture raw output, exit/signal and any durable partial completions.
Query the affected current closure from a separate process using runtime.ownership.read.
Query the independent control scope with its unchanged source/dependency closure.
Issue historical:true explicitly only via the public reader and preserve its returned historical label.
required_observations: Affected current closure returns HOLD with actual reason/evidence; never old stale ready.
Unchanged independent scope remains ready if no shared mandatory authority/manifest is corrupt.
Rebuild failure does not activate an incomplete manifest.
Explicit historical access remains trust gated and visibly historical.
Attempts with unknown forwarding/result retain UNCERTAIN reservation.
cases.baseline_gap: readOwnership checks current input equality, and rebuildOwnershipUpdate returns HOLD for blocked output/evaluation or may propagate thrown errors, but the entire drift -> failed real rebuild -> separate composed reader sequence has not been run here.
